difficulty_reason: The selected bidirectional classification requires an explicit anticommuting tensor-signing construction that distinguishes real from complex entries in the allowed dimensions. Its nonexistence direction requires the complete staircase-to-folded-cube map, nondegenerate square images and exhaustive boundary-edge occurrence pairing to produce an odd square obstruction. Those interacting construction and parity obligations exceed routine matrix multiplication or an invocation of Huang; the source’s simple Huang-transfer theorem and supporting variants are not separate selected units.
